description.value: The study compares structural gray-matter atrophy and its associations with face recognition, emotion recognition, and theory of mind in bvFTD and PNFA relative to healthy controls.

spans.text: In this study, we describe the differential patterns of brain atrophy that are associated with face recognition, emotional processing, and ToM deficits in a sample of PNFA in comparison with bvFTD patients and control subjects.
